name: mirage
text: Got your diagnostics report (v1.0.134, installed a few minutes before it). Here's how I read it. (1) The 15 s start was probably the first run after the install, when Android compiles the app. Please close the app fully, reopen it, and send a second report so I can see the real start time. (2) The app still has 33% slow frames while idle. Settings is 30% slow and the +EV tab 20%. (3) bets.json is still 8 MB and is still rewritten whole on every change. The 1.0.134 start-up fix didn't touch that, so it's my next fix. (4) Two failures need you: the ParlayAPI key ending 10d2 is refused (it's on the free plan, so replace it or turn ParlayAPI off), and Android notifications are off for Vigilant. (5) CNO's bets show -0.4% CLV over 101 bets, so its edges aren't proving real. I've logged all of this as PF11 in the task list.
